title: Cockpit
description: Panel behaviour that is not part of a layout: brightness, theme, idle dimming, the layout push port.

keys.name: theme
keys.title: Theme
keys.description: Panel colors. Auto uses the layout's theme, and switches between day and night with environment.mode.

keys.name: idle_s
keys.title: Idle dim after
keys.description: Dim the backlight when nothing was touched for this long. 0 = never.

keys.name: api_port
keys.title: Layout API port
keys.description: TCP port of the JSON Layout Player API the designer talks to (/layout, /hello, /screenshot).

keys.name: wake_host
keys.title: Network wake host
keys.description: Host running signalk-openwakeword (usually the SignalK server). Empty = on-device WakeNet ("Hi ESP").

keys.name: wake_word
keys.title: Network wake word
keys.description: Model name signalk-openwakeword must detect (must match a model the plugin loads). Only with a wake host.
